info.name: SmolOrchestrator
info.description: Lightweight OpenAI-compatible AI gateway. Gateway endpoints use OpenAI error shapes; admin endpoints use the { success, data } / { success, error, code } envelope. Admin mutations require the X-CSRF-Token header captured by the Login request.

request.description: 200 { status: 'ok' }.
200 { status: 'ready' }; 503 { status: 'unavailable', error } when the database is unreachable.

Prometheus text exposition (version 0.0.4): requests by model/provider/outcome, tokens by direction, estimated cost, probe results, budget rejections, route health gauges, uptime. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <METRICS_TOKEN>` when METRICS_TOKEN is configured; open otherwise.
200 { object: 'list', data: [{ id, object, created, owned_by }] } scoped to the token. 401 { error: { message, type, code } }.

OpenAI-compatible chat proxy. `stream: true` responses are SSE and the gateway injects stream_options.include_usage when absent. Any other POST under /v1/* is routed the same way when the JSON body carries a `model` field. Deterministic requests (temperature 0, non-stream) may be served from the exact response cache; responses carry X-Smolorchestrator-Provider, X-Cache (hit/miss/coalesced), X-Request-Cost when known, and X-Budget-Remaining/X-Budget-Warning headers. 200 passthrough; 400 invalid_json/invalid_request_error/unsupported_feature; 401 invalid_api_key; 404 model_not_found; 413 payload_too_large; 429 rate_limit_exceeded/budget_exceeded; 502 all_providers_failed.
OpenAI-compatible embeddings proxy; same routing and error shapes as chat completions.
OpenAI-compatible image proxy; same routing and error shapes as chat completions.
200 { success: true, data: { email, csrf } } and sets the HttpOnly session cookie. 401 invalid_credentials; 429 locked. Run this first: it populates the csrf collection variable.
200 { success: true, data: { email, csrf } }; 401 unauthorized.
200 { success: true, data: {} } and clears the session cookie. Requires CSRF header.
200 { success: true, data: { models: [{ id, name, balanceStrategy, routes: [...] }] } }.
201 { success: true, data: { id, name, balanceStrategy } }. balanceStrategy is round_robin, least_used, or cache_aware. 422 validation_error (invalid name or strategy, duplicate name).
200 { success: true, data: model }. Accepts name, balanceStrategy (round_robin, least_used, cache_aware), and cacheEnabled (exact response cache for temperature=0 requests).
200 { success: true, data: { id } }. Soft-deletes the model and its routes.
200 { success: true, data: { routes: [{ id, providerId, upstreamModel, priority, inputCostPerM, outputCostPerM, dailyQuota, consecutiveFailures, cooldownUntil }] } }.

201 { success: true, data: route }. dailyQuota null/omitted means unlimited; an integer caps daily requests for this route. inputCostPerM/outputCostPerM/cachedInputCostPerM are optional: null auto-prices from the built-in reference map (cached cost falls back to the cached_input_discount setting), 0 is explicitly free. capabilities is null (unrestricted), [] (declares none), or a subset of tools/vision/audio/json/reasoning. maxContext rejects requests whose estimated input plus max_tokens exceeds it.
200 { success: true, data: route }. Any subset of providerId, upstreamModel, priority, inputCostPerM, outputCostPerM, dailyQuota.
200 { success: true, data: { id } }. Soft delete.
200 { success: true, data: { providers: [{ id, name, baseUrl, keys: [{ id, label, enabled, disabledUntil }] }] } }. Plaintext keys are never returned.
201 { success: true, data: provider }. baseUrl must be an http(s) OpenAI-compatible root.
200 { success: true, data: provider }. Accepts name and/or baseUrl.
200 { success: true, data: { id } }. Soft-deletes the provider together with its keys and routes.
200 { success: true, data: { models: [{ id }] } }. Calls the provider's /models with a pooled key; 422 when the provider has no usable key or the upstream call fails.
201 { success: true, data: { id, providerId, label, enabled } }. The key is encrypted at rest and entered into the provider's rotation pool.
200 { success: true, data: { id, providerId, label, enabled } }. Enabling clears any temporary 401/403 disable window.
200 { success: true, data: { id } }. Soft-removes the key from the rotation pool.

200 { success: true, data: { tokens: [{ id, label, enabled, createdAt, modelIds, dailyRequestLimit, monthlyRequestLimit, dailySpendLimit, monthlySpendLimit, budgetUsage, budgetWarnings, budgetRemaining }] } }.

201 { success: true, data: { id, label, enabled, createdAt, dailyRequestLimit, monthlyRequestLimit, dailySpendLimit, monthlySpendLimit, raw } }. Budget fields are optional and null/omitted means unlimited. The raw key is returned exactly once; only its SHA-256 hash is stored.
200 { success: true, data: token }. Accepts label, enabled, and the four budget fields (dailyRequestLimit, monthlyRequestLimit, dailySpendLimit, monthlySpendLimit); null clears a limit.
200 { success: true, data: { id } }. Soft-deletes the token and clears its scope.
200 { success: true, data: { modelIds: [...] } }. Replaces the scope; /v1/models and routing honour it immediately.

200 { success: true, data: { usage: [...], cacheStats: [{ model, hits, misses, coalesced, saved_cost, saved_tokens_in, saved_tokens_out }], latency: [{ model, provider, requests, p50, p95 }] } }. Optional filters: entity (model|token|provider|route), windowStart (epoch ms).

200 { success: true, data: { telemetry: [{ ts, token_id, model_id, route_id, attempt, status, latency_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, est_cost, bytes, estimated, is_probe, error }] } }. No prompt or completion content is stored.
200 { success: true, data: { settings: { backoff_base_ms, backoff_cap_ms, probe_enabled, probe_budget_per_hour } } }.

200 { success: true, data: { settings, cacheEntries } }. All keys are optional (partial updates). Boolean: probe_enabled, health_check_enabled, response_cache_enabled, trust_proxy, cookie_secure. Numeric: backoff_base_ms, backoff_cap_ms, probe_budget_per_hour, health_check_interval_ms, response_cache_ttl_ms, response_cache_max_entries, response_cache_max_body_bytes, response_cache_max_total_bytes, cached_input_discount (0-1), budget_warn_ratio (0-1), telemetry_retention_days, usage_retention_days, max_attempts (<=64), idle_timeout_ms, key_disable_ms, key_retries_per_route, probe_max_tokens, max_body_bytes, usage_parse_max_bytes, ip_rate_limit, ip_rate_window_ms, login_max_attempts, login_lockout_ms, session_ttl_ms, telemetry_buffer_max, telemetry_flush_ms, backup_interval_ms, backup_keep, maintenance_interval_ms. Strings: probe_prompt (non-empty), metrics_token (empty allowed). Runtime keys apply immediately; timer intervals (telemetry_flush_ms, backup_interval_ms, maintenance_interval_ms) apply on next start.
200 { success: true, data: { cleared } }. Empties the exact response cache; entries are also invalidated automatically when their model, routes, or provider change.
200 { success: true, data: { backups: [{ name, sizeBytes, createdAt }], enabled, intervalMs, keep } }.
201 { success: true, data: { backup: { name, sizeBytes, createdAt } } }. Runs VACUUM INTO and prunes beyond BACKUP_KEEP.

200 { success: true, data: { bundle, warning } }. Bundle v1: models with routes (provider by name, costs, capabilities, maxContext), providers, and tokens (hashes, budgets, model names). secrets=1 includes encrypted provider keys, importable only where APP_SECRET matches.

200 { success: true, data: { created: { providers, keys, models, routes, tokens }, skipped: {...} } }. Merge-only: existing records are skipped, nothing is deleted. Provider secrets import only when encrypted with this instance's APP_SECRET.
